record.title: Pretrained ASR Pseudo-labeling for Noisy Police Audio
record.summary: arXiv:2609.30469v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pretrained ASR systems perform poorly on noisy Broadcast Police Communication (BPC), hindering efforts to understand police decision-making. Pseudo-labeling offers an unsupervised path to improve ASR without expensive human labels,
